scenarios.title: Athena: target and landing point

scenarios.vehicle: IM-2 Athena site comparison with the same generic assumed panel at both points
scenarios.communication: Compare computed Earth visibility at both points; this is not an explanation of mission failure.
watch: Small differences in computed sunlight and Earth gaps.

scenarios.title: A recommended region and the target

scenarios.vehicle: Generic lander, identical assumed vertical tracking panels
scenarios.communication: Compare recorded Earth visibility; the ranking also depends on terrain and the recorded weights.
watch: The first candidate in the recorded recommendation.
Sunlight, darkness and Earth gaps in the comparison.
